lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਇਸੁ ਮਨਹਿ ਨਚਾਏ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohu is manahi nachaae a(n)tar kapat dukh paavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: The love of Maya makes this mind dance, and the deceit within makes people suffer in pain. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh bhagat jaa aap karaae ||
lines.translation: When the Lord inspires one to become Gurmukh, and perform devotional worship,

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man raataa sahaj subhaae ||
lines.translation: then his body and mind are attuned to His Love with intuitive ease.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਵਜੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਜਾਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: baanee vajai sabad vajaae guramukh bhagat thaai paavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: The Word of His Bani vibrates, and the Word of His Shabad resounds, for the Gurmukh whose devotional worship is accepted. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਤਾਲ ਪੂਰੇ ਵਾਜੇ ਵਜਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahu taal poore vaaje vajaae ||
lines.translation: One may beat upon and play all sorts of instruments,

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਸੁਣੇ ਨ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa ko sune na ma(n)n vasaae ||
lines.translation: but no one will listen, and no one will enshrine it in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾਰਣਿ ਪਿੜ ਬੰਧਿ ਨਾਚੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa kaaran piR ba(n)dh naachai doojai bhaai dukh paavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: For the sake of Maya, they set the stage and dance, but they are in love with duality, and they obtain only sorrow. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis a(n)tar preet lagai so mukataa ||
lines.translation: Those whose inner beings are attached to the Lord's Love are liberated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਵਸਿ ਸਚ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: i(n)dree vas sach sa(n)jam jugataa ||
lines.translation: They control their sexual desires, and their lifestyle is the self-discipline of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਏ ਏਹਾ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad sadaa har dhiaae ehaa bhagat har bhaavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they meditate forever on the Lord. This devotional worship is pleasing to the Lord. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰੇ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh bhagat jug chaare hoee ||
lines.translation: To live as Gurmukh is devotional worship, throughout the four ages.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਤੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਏ ਕੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: horat bhagat na paae koee ||
lines.translation: This devotional worship is not obtained by any other means.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੦॥੨੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam gur bhagatee paaeeai gur charanee chit laavaniaa ||8||20||21||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained only through devotion to the Guru. So focus your consciousness on the Guru's Feet. ||8||20||21||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸੇਵੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa sevee sach saalaahee ||
lines.translation: Serve the True One, and praise the True One.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai naai dukh kab hee naahee ||
lines.translation: With the True Name, pain shall never afflict you.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sukhadaataa sevan sukh paain guramat ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: Those who serve the Giver of peace find peace. They enshrine the Guru's Teachings within their minds. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਵਾਰੀ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਵਣਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau vaaree jeeu vaaree sukh sahaj samaadh lagaavaniaa ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who intuitively enter into the peace of Samaadhi.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੇ ਸਦਾ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo har sevahi se sadaa sohahi sobhaa surat suhaavaniaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Those who serve the Lord are always beautiful. The glory of their intuitive awareness is beautiful. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਕਹਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ko teraa bhagat kahaae ||
lines.translation: All call themselves Your devotees,

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਈ ਭਗਤ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: seee bhagat terai man bhaae ||
lines.translation: but they alone are Your devotees, who are pleasing to Your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਤੁਧੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sach baanee tudhai saalaahan ra(n)g raate bhagat karaavaniaa ||2||
lines.translation: Through the True Word of Your Bani, they praise You; attuned to Your Love, they worship You with devotion. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਸਚੇ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ko sache har jeeu teraa ||
lines.translation: All are Yours, O Dear True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਾ ਚੂਕੈ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh milai taa chookai pheraa ||
lines.translation: Meeting the Gurmukh, this cycle of reincarnation comes to an end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਨਾਇ ਰਚਾਵਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਨਾਉ ਜਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jaa tudh bhaavai taa naai rachaavahi too(n) aape naau japaavaniaa ||3||
lines.translation: When it pleases Your Will, then we merge in the Name. You Yourself inspire us to chant the Name. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee har ma(n)n vasaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, I enshrine the Lord within my mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਖੁ ਸੋਗੁ ਸਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: harakh sog sabh mohu gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Pleasure and pain, and all emotional attachments are gone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੪॥
lines.transliteration: ikas siu liv laagee sad hee har naam ma(n)n vasaavaniaa ||4||
lines.translation: I am lovingly centered on the One Lord forever. I enshrine the Lord's Name within my mind. ||4||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat ra(n)g raate sadaa terai chaae ||
lines.translation: Your devotees are attuned to Your Love; they are always joyful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: nau nidh naam vasiaa man aae ||
lines.translation: The nine treasures of the Naam come to dwell within their minds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਬਦੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: poorai bhaag satigur paaiaa sabade mel milaavaniaa ||5||
lines.translation: By perfect destiny, they find the True Guru, and through the Word of the Shabad, they are united in the Lord's Union. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) daiaal sadaa sukhadaataa ||
lines.translation: You are Merciful, and always the Giver of peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿਹਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) aape melihi guramukh jaataa ||
lines.translation: You Yourself unite us; You are known only to the Gurmukhs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) aape devahi naam vadaaee naam rate sukh paavaniaa ||6||
lines.translation: You Yourself bestow the glorious greatness of the Naam; attuned to the Naam, we find peace. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sadaa saache tudh saalaahee ||
lines.translation: Forever and ever, O True Lord, I praise You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jaataa doojaa ko naahee ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, I know no other at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕਸੁ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਏ ਮਨਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਮਨਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: ekas siu man rahiaa samaae man ma(n)niai manahi milaavaniaa ||7||
lines.translation: My mind remains immersed in the One Lord; my mind surrenders to Him, and in my mind I meet Him. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovai so saalaahe ||
lines.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh, praises the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saache thaakur veparavaahe ||
lines.translation: Our True Lord and Master is Carefree.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੮॥੨੧॥੨੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vasai man a(n)tar gurasabadee har melaavaniaa ||8||21||22||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides deep within the mind; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we merge with the Lord. ||8||21||22||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: maajh mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Maajh, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tere bhagat sohahi saachai darabaare ||
lines.translation: Your devotees look beautiful in the True Court.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad naam savaare ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they are adorned with the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦਿ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਾਵਣਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa ana(n)d rahahi din raatee gun kahi gunee samaavaniaa ||1||
lines.translation: They are forever in bliss, day and night; chanting the Glorious Praises of the Lord, they merge with the Lord of Glory. ||1||
